amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Carbon Neutrality
amendmentHistory.notes: Amended "accessory use" to add (20) composting and (21) accessory mechanical equipment; amended "automotive service station" to add EV charging; amended "floor area" to relocate mechanical equipment descriptions to accessory use, changed reference of exterior wall thickness to the new defined term "qualifying exterior wall thickness", and added new paragraph for the exemption for "fully electrified buildings" and "ultra low energy buildings"; amended "private road" x-ref to 37-10; amended "public parking garage" and "public parking lot" for consistency with new underlying regulations by removing prohibitions on commercial/public utility vehicles and deleting references to sale of motor fuels. Added new definition for "automated parking facility" (relocated from Manhattan Core regulations to have citywide applicability); and added new definitions for "energy infrastructure equipment", "fully electrified building", "qualifying exterior wall thickness", "qualifying rooftop greenhouse", and "ultra low energy building".
